title: Circle Calculator
description: Enter radius, diameter, circumference or area — get all four circle properties with the formulas shown.
howto: Press Calculate to get radius, diameter, circumference and area.

faqs.q: How is radius found from area?
faqs.a: From A = πr², so r = √(A / π).

faqs.q: What is the difference between diameter and circumference?
faqs.a: Diameter is the straight line through the center (2r); circumference is the distance around the circle (2πr).
They use the full precision of π in JavaScript, rounded to 6 decimals for display.
